name: hcapp_rptKennelRunStats
description: Authenticated passthrough to HC.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats. Validates the device token via HC6.ValidateAppAuth (spNumber=51) then delegates entirely to the internal nonApi SP. This is a read SP — no success envelope is returned. On auth failure, a single error rowset is returned and execution halts. On success, the rowset(s) produced by HC.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats are passed through directly. The nonApi SP is an internal database object not under source control; its exact rowset schema is not captured in this contract.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to ValidateAppAuth to resolve the calling user and their device secret.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token validated by ValidateAppAuth against the device secret.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel to report on. Passed directly to HC.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats after auth succeeds.

rowsets.name: AuthError
rowsets.description: Returned when ValidateAppAuth rejects the request (bad token, unknown device, expired token, etc.). errorType follows the HC6 app error code scheme. Only returned on failure — not present on the success path.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry logged by ValidateAppAuth.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Specific error code within the errorType category.

rowsets.name: KennelRunStatsResult
rowsets.description: Returned on the success path. Contains whatever HC.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats returns for the given @kennelId. The nonApi SP is an internal database object not under source control — its exact column schema is not defined here. See HC.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats directly for the rowset definition.

codeSmells.detail: The SP has no TRY/CATCH around the delegated EXEC HC.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats call. Any SQL error raised inside the nonApi SP will propagate as an unhandled exception with no standard HC6 error envelope. A TRY/CATCH should wrap the post-auth execution path.

codeSmells.issue: Rowset contract incomplete — depends on undocumented nonApi SP
codeSmells.detail: HC.nonApi_rptKennelRunStats is an internal SP whose source is not in the repository and whose rowset schema is not captured in this contract. If the nonApi SP schema changes the app will break silently. HC6 should either inline the nonApi logic or document its rowset contract separately.

The SP passes @kennelId directly to the nonApi SP without checking whether it resolves to a known kennel. If the nonApi SP does not perform this check itself, an invalid kennelId will return an empty rowset with no error signal, which the caller may not be able to distinguish from a valid-but-empty result.

breakingChanges: Auth model changed from HC5 inline device lookup + HC.CHECK_ACCESS_TOKEN_V2 call to HC6 ValidateAppAuth helper SP — callers must pass a token generated by the HC6 auth flow.
Error rowset column set changed: HC5 error rowsets included 'debugMessage'; HC6 error rowset (from ValidateAppAuth) does not expose debugMessage to callers — it is logged internally only.
HC5 had a @timeWindows typo (extra 's') in the local variable name — corrected in HC6 to @timeWindow. No caller-visible impact.
